invariants.rationale: The method returns either fileId or a value from super.getFileIdPfx, both of which are expected to be non-null.
If fileId is set, result is always equal to fileId.
If fileId is not set (null), result cannot equal fileId because fileId is null.
If fileId is null, result is delegated from the super implementation.
FileIds or their prefixes are typically non-empty strings.
